subject: 飛行原理與飛控系統 - 基本飛控系統 (Primary Flight Controls)

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於「逆偏航」(Adverse Yaw) 的成因與特性，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 主要是由於向上偏轉的副翼產生了額外的寄生阻力 (Parasitic Drag)
(B) 主要是由於向下偏轉的副翼在產生升力的同時，也產生了較大的誘導阻力 (Induced Drag)
(C) 飛機的機頭會朝向轉彎的方向偏轉
(D) 這種現象在高速飛行時比低速飛行時更為明顯
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the cause and characteristics of 'Adverse Yaw', which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) It is primarily caused by extra parasitic drag from the upward-deflected aileron
(B) It is primarily caused by the downward-deflected aileron creating more induced drag while generating lift
(C) The nose of the aircraft yaws toward the direction of the turn
(D) This phenomenon is more pronounced at high airspeeds than at low airspeeds
mc_questions.explanation: 逆偏航 (Adverse Yaw) 是因為轉彎時，向下偏轉的副翼 (downward-deflected aileron) 增加了翼型彎度進而增加升力，但同時也產生了較大的誘導阻力 (Induced Drag)，導致機頭偏向轉彎的反方向。此現象在低速、高攻角或大副翼偏轉時最為明顯。

mc_questions.zh_question: 差動式副翼 (Differential Ailerons) 是如何修正逆偏航 (Adverse Yaw) 現象的？
zh_options: (A) 透過彈簧機構將副翼與方向舵 (Rudder) 進行物理連動
(B) 使向上偏轉的副翼角度大於向下偏轉的副翼角度
(C) 在向下偏轉的副翼前端突出一塊構造以產生阻力
(D) 增加副翼的總面積以提高操縱效率
mc_questions.en_question: How do differential ailerons correct the phenomenon of adverse yaw?
en_options: (A) By physically linking the ailerons and rudder through a spring mechanism
(B) By making the upward-deflected aileron move a greater distance than the downward-deflected aileron
(C) By having a protrusion on the downward-deflected aileron to create drag
(D) By increasing the total area of the ailerons to improve control effectiveness
mc_questions.explanation: 差動式副翼 (Differential Ailerons) 的設計邏輯是讓「向上偏轉」的副翼行程大於「向下偏轉」的角度。這樣可以在下降翼 (descending wing) 產生更多的阻力，用以抵消上升翼 (rising wing) 因產生升力而產生的誘導阻力，進而減少逆偏航。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於 T 型尾翼 (T-tail) 飛機發生「深 stall」(Deep Stall，又稱 Super Stall) 的邏輯，下列何者錯誤？
zh_options: (A) 常發生在高攻角 (High AOA) 且空速極低的狀況下
(B) 主翼產生的亂流 (Wake) 會遮蔽水平安定面，導致升降舵失效
(C) 後重心 (Aft CG) 通常是導致無法從深 stall 中恢復的促進因素
(D) 由於 T 型尾翼位置較高，完全不會受到主翼下洗流 (Downwash) 的影響
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the logic of 'Deep Stall' (or Super Stall) in T-tail aircraft, which of the following is incorrect?
en_options: (A) It often occurs at a high angle of attack (AOA) with very low airspeed
(B) The wake from the main wing blankets the horizontal stabilizer, making the elevator ineffective
(C) An aft center of gravity (Aft CG) is often a contributing factor in the inability to recover
(D) Because of its high position, a T-tail is completely unaffected by the main wing's downwash
mc_questions.explanation: 雖然 T 型尾翼在正常飛行時能避開主翼亂流，但在極高攻角時，主翼產生的紊亂氣流 (Wake) 會向上後方遮蔽高處的水平尾翼，導致飛行員無法透過推桿 (nose down) 來恢復。選項 D 說「完全不會受到影響」是錯誤的，且後重心 (Aft CG) 會惡化此狀況。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在 T 型尾翼 (T-tail) 飛機中，安裝「升降舵下偏彈簧 (Elevator Down Spring)」的主要目的是什麼？
zh_options: (A) 在著陸拉平 (Flare) 時提供額外的升力
(B) 當配平片 (Trim tab) 效能不足時，確保升降舵能移向低頭位置以防止失速
(C) 增加升降舵在高空飛行時的靈敏度
(D) 抵銷 V 型尾翼常見的荷蘭滾 (Dutch Roll) 傾向
mc_questions.en_question: What is the primary purpose of an elevator down spring on a T-tail aircraft?
en_options: (A) To provide additional lift during the landing flare
(B) To drive the elevator to a nose-down position if the trim tab becomes ineffective, preventing a stall
(C) To increase the sensitivity of the elevator during high-altitude flight
(D) To counteract the Dutch Roll tendency common in V-tail designs
mc_questions.explanation: 在低速或高攻角 (High AOA) 情況下，若配平片失效，下偏彈簧能機械性地驅動升降舵向 nose-down 方向偏轉，強制降低機頭以維持速度並避免 deep stall。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於全動式平尾 (Stabilator) 上的反伺服片 (Anti-servo Tab)，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 其移動方向與全動式平尾的後緣相反
(B) 其移動方向與全動式平尾的後緣相同，用以增加操縱感與穩定性
(C) 僅在飛機失速時由自動駕駛系統觸發
(D) 其主要功能是減少操縱面阻力以節省燃油
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the anti-servo tab on a stabilator, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) It moves in the opposite direction of the stabilator trailing edge
(B) It moves in the same direction as the trailing edge to increase control feel and stability
(C) It is only triggered by the autopilot during a stall
(D) Its primary function is to reduce control surface drag to save fuel
mc_questions.explanation: Anti-servo tab 隨操縱面同向偏轉，會產生反向力矩，增加飛行員操作時的 feel 並使 Stabilator 更容易回到中立位置，增加穩定性。

mc_questions.zh_question: 富勒襟翼 (Fowler Flaps) 與一般襟翼 (Plain Flaps) 最主要的差別為何？
zh_options: (A) 富勒襟翼只會改變機翼弧度 (Camber)
(B) 富勒襟翼在伸放時會沿軌道後滑，同時增加機翼弧度與機翼面積 (Wing Area)
(C) 富勒襟翼僅用於高速戰鬥機，民航機並不使用
(D) 富勒襟翼透過噴射發動機引氣來增加升力
mc_questions.en_question: What is the primary difference between Fowler flaps and plain flaps?
en_options: (A) Fowler flaps only change the wing camber
(B) Fowler flaps slide backwards on tracks, increasing both wing camber and wing area
(C) Fowler flaps are only used on high-speed fighters, not on civil aircraft
(D) Fowler flaps use engine bleed air to increase lift
mc_questions.explanation: Fowler flaps 獨特之處在於它會向後方滑動，這不僅改變了機翼的 Camber，還實質增加了 Wing area，提供更強的增升效果。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於「地面可調式配平片」(Ground Adjustable Tabs) 的調整與確認過程，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 飛行員可在座艙內透過配平輪即時調整
(B) 調整量是透過「試誤法」(trial and error) 並在飛行中觀察是否仍有側滑現象來確定的
(C) 該配平片由馬達驅動，根據空速自動彎曲
(D) 僅安裝於方向舵上，且調整後不影響座艙內的指示
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding Ground Adjustable Tabs, which of the following statements is correct?
en_options: (A) The pilot can adjust it in real-time via a trim wheel in the cockpit
(B) The correct displacement is determined by trial and error and confirmed when the aircraft no longer skids during flight
(C) The tab is motor-driven and bends automatically based on airspeed
(D) It is only installed on the rudder and its adjustment does not affect cockpit indications
mc_questions.explanation: 地面可調式配平片 (Ground Adjustable Tabs) 是固定式的金屬片，必須在地面手動彎曲。其正確的偏轉量需透過試誤法 (trial and error) 判定，直到飛機在正常巡航時不再向左或向右側滑 (skid) 為止。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在「可調式水平安定面」(Adjustable Stabilizer) 系統中，安定面是如何改變角度以達成配平的？
zh_options: (A) 繞著其前樑 (Front Spar) 進行旋轉
(B) 透過安裝在後樑 (Rear Spar) 的千斤頂螺桿 (Jackscrew) 調整
(C) 繞著其後樑 (Rear Spar) 樞轉，並由前緣的千斤頂螺桿驅動
(D) 僅透過改變安定面上的配平片位置來達成
mc_questions.en_question: In an Adjustable Stabilizer system, how is the stabilizer's angle changed for trimming?
en_options: (A) It rotates around its front spar
(B) It is adjusted via a jackscrew mounted on the rear spar
(C) It pivots about its rear spar and is actuated by a jackscrew on the leading edge
(D) It is only achieved by changing the position of the trim tab on the stabilizer
mc_questions.explanation: 可調式水平安定面 (Adjustable Stabilizer) 是繞著後樑 (rear spar) 轉動，並利用安裝在安定面前緣 (leading edge) 的千斤頂螺桿 (jackscrew) 來改變攻角，進而達成配平目的。

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據音訊內容，單軸自動駕駛系統 (Single-axis Autopilot) 主要控制飛機的哪一個軸向？
zh_options: (A) 垂直軸 (Vertical Axis)，控制方向舵 (Rudder)
(B) 橫軸 (Lateral Axis)，控制升降舵 (Elevator)
(C) 縱軸 (Longitudinal Axis)，控制副翼 (Ailerons)
(D) 所有三軸方向的平衡
mc_questions.en_question: According to the audio, what axis does a single-axis autopilot primarily control?
en_options: (A) Vertical Axis, controlling the rudder
(B) Lateral Axis, controlling the elevator
(C) Longitudinal Axis, controlling the ailerons
(D) All three axes of balance
mc_questions.explanation: 單軸自動駕駛儀 (Single-axis autopilot) 控制飛機繞縱軸 (Longitudinal axis) 的運動，即滾轉控制，並透過驅動副翼 (ailerons) 來達成。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The primary flight control system consists of the {{c1::ailerons, elevator, and rudder}}, which are required to control the aircraft safely during flight.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 主要飛行控制系統由副翼、升降舵和方向舵組成，這些是飛行中安全控制飛機所必需的。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是基礎定義，副翼控制滾轉，升降舵控制俯仰，方向舵控制偏航。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Ailerons control roll about the {{c1::longitudinal}} axis.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 副翼控制繞著縱軸的滾轉運動。
cloze_items.explanation: 縱軸 (Longitudinal axis) 是指從機頭穿過機尾的假想軸。

cloze_items.cloze_text: At {{c1::low airspeeds}}, the controls usually feel soft and sluggish, and the aircraft responds slowly to control applications.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在低空速下，控制通常感覺柔軟且遲鈍，飛機對控制輸入的反應較慢。
cloze_items.explanation: 因為流經控制面的氣流壓力較小，導致操縱感 (Control feel) 變得鬆散。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The {{c1::Frise-type}} aileron projects its leading edge into the airflow to create drag on the ascending wing, helping to equalize drag.
cloze_items.zh_translation: Frise 型副翼會將其前緣伸入氣流中，在上升翼一側產生阻力，有助於平衡阻力。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是另一種減輕逆偏航 (Adverse Yaw) 的機械設計方法。

cloze_items.cloze_text: In a T-tail aircraft, the elevator is above most of the effects of {{c1::downwash}} from the propeller and airflow around the fuselage.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在 T 型尾翼飛機中，升降舵位於螺旋槳下洗流及機身周圍氣流的大部分影響之外。
cloze_items.explanation: 這使得 T 型尾翼在一般飛行狀態下具有較佳的控制穩定性與平順感。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A canard design functions as a horizontal stabilizer located in {{c1::front}} of the main wings.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 前置翼 (Canard) 設計的功能類似於水平安定面，但位於主翼的前方。
cloze_items.explanation: 前置翼能產生向上升力，與傳統後置式水平尾翼產生的向下力量邏輯不同。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The movable surfaces on a V-tail are connected through a special linkage called {{c1::ruddervators}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: V 型尾翼上的可動操縱面透過特殊的連桿連接，稱為「升降舵方向舵 (ruddervators)」。
cloze_items.explanation: 它是 Elevator 與 Rudder 的結合體，同時提供俯仰與偏航控制。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Slotted flaps allow high energy air from the lower surface to be ducted to the upper surface, delaying {{c1::airflow separation}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 縫隙襟翼允許來自下表面的高能空氣引導至上表面，從而延緩氣流分離。
cloze_items.explanation: 這能讓飛機在更高的攻角下仍能維持升力，提供更好的低速操縱性。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A servo tab is a dynamic device that moves in response to pilot input to help {{c1::decrease}} the pilot's work load.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 伺服片 (Servo tab) 是一種動態裝置，隨飛行員輸入移動以幫助減輕操作負荷。
cloze_items.explanation: 常見於大型飛機，利用空氣動力輔助偏轉主操縱面。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Ground adjustable tabs are adjusted until the aircraft no longer {{c1::skids}} left or right during normal cruise flight.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 地面可調式配平片需持續調整，直到飛機在正常巡航飛行中不再向左或向右側滑為止。
cloze_items.explanation: 側滑 (skid) 指的是飛機在飛行中機頭指向與飛行路徑不一致的側向運動。

cloze_items.cloze_text: On large aircraft, the adjustable stabilizer is usually {{c1::motor driven}} rather than cable operated.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在大型飛機上，可調式水平安定面通常是由馬達驅動，而非鋼繩操作。
cloze_items.explanation: 小型飛機常使用鋼繩、配平輪或曲柄操作，大型飛機則需馬達提供更大動力。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Autopilot reduces the physical and {{c1::mental demands}} on a pilot and increases safety.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 自動駕駛系統能減輕飛行員的體力與精神負擔，並提升安全性。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是自動駕駛系統在長途飛行或複雜操作環境下的核心效益。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A three-axis autopilot actuates ailerons, {{c1::elevator}}, and rudder.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 三軸自動駕駛系統會驅動副翼、升降舵以及方向舵。
cloze_items.explanation: 三軸系統涵蓋了縱軸 (Roll)、橫軸 (Pitch) 以及垂直軸 (Yaw) 的完整控制。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Autopilot systems incorporate a {{c1::disconnect}} safety feature to disengage the system automatically or manually.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 自動駕駛系統具備脫離 (disconnect) 安全功能，可自動或手動解除系統連動。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是一項關鍵的安全機制，確保在異常情況下飛行員能立即取回控制權。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The primary source of information for flight control systems is the {{c1::AFM}} or the POH.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 關於飛行控制系統的主要資訊來源是飛機飛行手冊 (AFM) 或飛行員操作手冊 (POH)。
cloze_items.explanation: 飛行員必須熟悉特定機型的操作手冊，因為不同飛機的控制邏輯差異極大。
